lines.en: label day287:
scene otohafirstday1
With the transfer process once again out of the way, today marks the first day of the rest of Otoha’s life.
lines.zh: 转学流程再一次尘埃落定，今天标志着 Otoha 余生的第一天。

lines.en: I decide to end my train of thought there to leave things on a positive note as I’m sure the rest of her life will be filled with turmoil and anguish.
lines.zh: 我决定把思路停在这里，好让一切收在一个积极的调子上，因为我敢肯定她的余生会充满动荡与痛苦。

lines.en: Such is the life of all of us.
lines.zh: 我们所有人的一生都是如此。

lines.en: But I guess the fact that I’ve already embellished on why I cut myself off sort of defeats the purpose of cutting myself off in the first place.
lines.zh: 不过我既然已经就「我为什么打住」大肆发挥了一番，那打住本身就有点失去意义了。

lines.en: Whoops.
lines.zh: 哎呀。

lines.en: But hey, at least now she has the entire[school] year (And every subsequent one for the foreseeable future) to keep doing the things she wants to do.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，至少现在她有一整个[school]年（以及在可预见的未来里之后的每一年）可以继续做自己想做的事。

lines.en: And her being around is sure to make Rin feel a little better as well.
lines.zh: 而她能待在这儿，肯定也会让 Rin 好受一些。

lines.en: At least for now.
lines.zh: 至少目前是这样。

lines.en: She doesn’t have the best track record with romance, so there’s always a chance things could go sour at a moment’s notice.
lines.zh: Rin 在恋爱这方面的战绩可不怎么样，所以事情随时都有可能急转直下。

lines.en: Such is the art of never knowing.
lines.zh: 这就是永远无从知晓的艺术。

lines.en: : Are you excited to never learn anything again for the rest of your life?
lines.zh: : 想到这辈子再也学不到任何东西了，你兴奋吗？

lines.en: : I...highly doubt we’ll be in this class for the rest of our lives, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我……非常怀疑我们会不会在这个班里待一辈子，Rin。

lines.en: Ha.
lines.zh: 哈。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday2
: I do want to say thanks again for totally-not-stalking me with Nodoka the other day, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我确实想再说一次谢谢，感谢前几天你和 Nodoka 完全没有跟踪我，Sensei。

lines.en: : If it wasn’t for you guys, I’d probably be spending the morning reading through some boring textbook in my bedroom while my mom makes tea.
lines.zh: : 如果不是你们，我大概这会儿正待在卧室里翻着什么无聊的课本，而我妈在泡茶。

lines.en: : Well the bedroom and the tea parts don’t sound bad. Textbooks are definitely not my thing, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯，卧室和茶那部分听起来倒不赖。不过课本绝对不是我的菜。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday3
: Sensei, be careful! If you say anything bad about textbooks, Makoto will storm out of the classroom and lecture you about it for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: : Sensei，小心点！你要是说了课本的坏话，Makoto 会冲出教室，然后就这事训你一整天。

lines.en: : Thanks, Rin. I can always count on you to watch my back.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Rin。我永远可以指望你帮我看着背后。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday4
: Of course. That’s what homies are for, right?
lines.zh: : 当然。兄弟本来就该这样，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s good knowing that you two are exactly the same inside of[school] as you are outside of it.
lines.zh: : 知道你们俩在[school]里和[school]外是完完全全一个样子，挺好的。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday5
: What's that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 你这话什么意思？

lines.en: : Not anything weird. I’m already getting used to this guy being overly friendly with [teenager]s.
lines.zh: : 没什么奇怪的意思。我已经慢慢习惯这家伙对[teenager]过分友好了。

lines.en: : I feel like those sentences contradicted each other.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这两句话互相矛盾了。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday6
: Nah. I just mean it’s cool that you’re not really focused on putting up a front or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 没有。我只是觉得你不用刻意装样子之类的，这挺酷的。

lines.en: : Like that whole “Serious guy on the inside, not serious guy on the outside” kind of thing.
lines.zh: : 就是那种「内心是个严肃的人，外表却一点也不严肃」的感觉。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure me revealing that you’ll be getting straight A’s in perpetuity should have said all you needed to know about how I am “on the inside.”
lines.zh: : 我敢说，我告诉你你将永远拿全 A 这件事，已经把你想知道的关于我「内在」的一切都说明白了。

lines.en: : That part’s still setting in. But yeah, definitely awesome.
lines.zh: : 那部分我还在慢慢消化。不过是啊，绝对很棒。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday7
: And don’t worry. The things he makes you do to keep your grades up are only scary the first few times.
lines.zh: : 还有别担心。他让你做那些事来维持成绩，只有头几次会吓人。

lines.en: : After that, it’s kind of exciting~
lines.zh: : 之后就有点刺激了~

lines.en: : What...sort of things are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 你……说的是什么样的事？

lines.en: scene otohafirstday8
: Don’t listen to Rin. I don’t expect anything in return for your grades.
lines.zh: : 别听 Rin 的。我不指望你拿成绩来换什么。

lines.en: : Though I won’t exactly reject any “donations” you’d be willing to give in exchange for them.
lines.zh: : 不过你若是愿意主动「捐赠」点什么作为交换，我也不会拒绝就是了。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday9
: Hey! Only I’m allowed to suggest stuff like that! It sounds serious when you do it!
lines.zh: : 喂！只有我可以提这种建议！换你说就变得很正经了！

lines.en: : I’m...good.
lines.zh: : 我……还是算了。

lines.en: : I’ll just...take the grades for nothing since you already promised that was the deal.
lines.zh: : 我就……直接白拿成绩好了，毕竟你答应过的就是这个条件。

lines.en: : Fair enough.
lines.zh: : 那也行。

lines.en: : Are you settled into the dorms yet or is that happening later?
lines.zh: : 你已经安顿进宿舍了吗，还是说要晚点？

lines.en: scene otohafirstday10
: I’m still with my parents for now, but I’ll be moving in with Nodoka by the end of the week.
lines.zh: : 我目前还和爸妈住，不过这周末之前会搬去和 Nodoka 一起住。

lines.en: : It wasn’t as hard to convince them to let me stay outside of the house as soon as I promised I’d be getting straight A’s from now on.
lines.zh: : 我一承诺从现在起会拿全 A，说服他们让我搬出家就没那么难了。

lines.en: : Ah, so you decided not to switch with Futaba and live with Rin after all?
lines.zh: : 啊，所以你最后还是决定不跟 Futaba 换、不和 Rin 住了？

lines.en: scene otohafirstday11
: That was an option?!
lines.zh: : 那也是一个选项？！

lines.en: : I would literally die!
lines.zh: : 我真的会死掉的！

lines.en: : Platonically, of course! Definitely not because I’m so attracted to her that I would never sleep again!
lines.zh: : 当然是柏拉图意义上的！绝对不是因为她太吸引我，搞得我从此再也睡不着觉！

lines.en: : Another great save, Rin.
lines.zh: : 又一次完美的圆场，Rin。

lines.en: : My nose isn’t bleeding again, is it?
lines.zh: : 我的鼻子没又流血吧？

lines.en: : That happened last week and I really hope it’s not going to be a recurring thing from now on.
lines.zh: : 上周就流过一次，我真的希望从今往后别变成常态。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : I just figured it would make more sense to room with Nodoka since, like...I’ve known her longer and...we’re both new here and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得和 Nodoka 住一间更合理，因为……我认识她更久，而且……我们俩都是新来的之类的。

lines.en: That makes total sense. I’m sure Rin has absolutely nothing to do with that decision at all.
lines.zh: 这完全说得通。我敢肯定 Rin 和这个决定一点关系都没有。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday12
: That’s fine! I completely understand!
lines.zh: : 没关系！我完全理解！

lines.en: : Besides, you’re going to be right upstairs anyway. So I’m sure we’ll still be hanging out all the time and stuff.
lines.zh: : 再说了，反正你就住在楼上。所以我们肯定还是会经常见面之类的。

lines.en: : If you’re not busy, of course. I get that you spend a lot of time practicing and...practice is...yeah.
lines.zh: : 当然，如果你不忙的话。我知道你花很多时间练习，然后……练习就是……嗯。

lines.en: : You get it.
lines.zh: : 你懂的。

lines.en: : I get it.
lines.zh: : 我懂。

lines.en: : Actually, Nodoka and I will probably need some help moving stuff into our room soon if you and Futaba want to give us a hand?
lines.zh: : 其实，Nodoka 和我大概过阵子需要人帮忙把东西搬进房间，你和 Futaba 想搭把手吗？

lines.en: scene otohafirstday13
: You can have more than a hand! You can have my entire body!
lines.zh: : 你何止能有一只手！你可以拥有我的整个身体！

lines.en: : I said that out loud, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我刚刚是说出口了吧？

lines.en: : Yup...
: Just a hand is fine for now, Rin.
lines.zh: : 目前只要一只手就够了，Rin。

lines.en: : Got it!
lines.zh: : 明白！

lines.en: : I’m gonna go inside the classroom and die now. Later, Otoha!
lines.zh: : 我要进教室去死一死了。回头见，Otoha！

lines.en: : Uhh...see you in a couple minutes, Rin.
lines.zh: : 呃……那几分钟后见，Rin。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday14
: I would once again like to apologize on her behalf.
lines.zh: : 我想再次代表她道个歉。

lines.en: : She’s just very excited to have you here.
lines.zh: : 她只是太高兴你能来这儿了。

lines.en: : Yeah...she seems to get excited pretty easily, huh?
lines.zh: : 是啊……她好像很容易就兴奋起来，是吧？

lines.en: : Lately, yeah. She goes through her rough patches, though.
lines.zh: : 最近是这样。不过她也有过低谷期。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday15
: She’s told me something like that before. There’s nothing we can do to prevent it, though, right?
lines.zh: : 她以前跟我说过类似的事。不过我们也没办法阻止，对吧？

lines.en: : Like, it just kind of happens?
lines.zh: : 就是……它自然而然就发生了？

lines.en: : Probably best to just play it by ear.
lines.zh: : 大概最好就是随机应变。

lines.en: : I’m admittedly not great at dealing with things like that. So if you’re also ever going to get all depressed, please give me the proper notice so I don’t make things worse.
lines.zh: : 说实话我不太擅长处理这种事。所以如果你哪天也要整个人消沉下去，请提前跟我说一声，免得我把事情弄得更糟。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday16
: I’ll do my best.
lines.zh: : 我尽量。

lines.en: : I’m normally pretty good at handling stuff like that on my own, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我通常挺擅长自己处理这种事的。

lines.en: : So don’t feel the need to worry about me even though you’re like...my new teacher slash guidance counselor or whatever.
lines.zh: : 所以哪怕你算是……我的新老师兼心理咨询师什么的，也不用替我担心。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday17
: Huh? Otoha?
lines.zh: : 嗯？Otoha？

lines.en: : What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Oh snap, Io! Are you in this class too?
lines.zh: : 哦哟，Io！你也在这个班？

lines.en: scene otohafirstday18
: Yup.
: Sensei is awesome. I’m sure you’ll like it here.
lines.zh: : Sensei 很棒。我敢肯定你会喜欢这儿的。

lines.en: : I take it you two are friends?
lines.zh: : 看来你们俩是朋友？

lines.en: scene otohafirstday19
: I don’t know if I’d say “friends.” Acquaintances is probably a better term.
lines.zh: : 我不知道算不算「朋友」。说认识的人可能更准确。

lines.en: : We had a few classes together in our last[school] and Otoha is one of the few people I don’t hate for simply existing.
lines.zh: : 我们上一所[school]有几节课在一起上，而 Otoha 是少数几个我不会仅仅因为她存在就讨厌的人之一。

lines.en: : Hooray for me.
lines.zh: : 我真幸运。

lines.en: : I guess your “girls are evil” stance isn’t as strong as I thought it was.
lines.zh: : 看来你那套「女生都是邪恶的」立场没我想的那么坚定啊。

lines.en: : Otoha is like, barely even a girl.
lines.zh: : Otoha 基本上……都不算是个女生。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday20
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : She was actually super popular {i}with{/i} girls in our last[school]. Like, I’m pretty sure more girls have confessed to her than boys.
lines.zh: : 她在上一所[school]里其实特别{i}受{/i}女生欢迎。我是说，我敢肯定向她告白的女生比男生还多。

lines.en: : I like her. Good pick, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢她。挑得好，Sensei。

lines.en: : Thanks, Io. Though it was more like Nodoka picked her than me.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Io。不过与其说是我挑的，不如说是 Nodoka 挑的。

lines.en: : Either way, nice.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，不错。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday21
: I’m gonna go sit down and not talk to anyone for the rest of the day now. But it was cool catching up.
lines.zh: : 我要去坐着了，接下来一整天都不打算跟任何人说话。不过能叙叙旧挺好的。

lines.en: : Yeah. See you in class...
lines.zh: : 嗯。课上见……

lines.en: scene otohafirstday22
: Hah...
: If it’s any consolation, I definitely view you as a girl.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受点的话，我绝对把你当女生看。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday23
: It’s weird cause like, that’s not even the first time I’ve heard that.
lines.zh: : 奇怪的是，这甚至不是我第一次听到这种话了。

lines.en: : Like...do I come off as boyish to you?
lines.zh: : 就是……我看起来很男孩子气吗？

lines.en: : Not so much boyish, but...maybe just really cool?
lines.zh: : 与其说男孩子气，不如说……也许只是特别酷？

lines.en: : Girls tend to like people they look up to, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 女生往往喜欢自己仰慕的人，不是吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’ve never really liked anyone before.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我以前从来没真正喜欢过谁。

lines.en: : How? You’re in [high_school].
lines.zh: : 怎么会？你可是[high_school]生了。

lines.en: : Well yeah, but it’s not like I’ve ever had time for a relationship or anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯是啊，可我从来就没有时间谈恋爱什么的。

lines.en: : And even if I did, there’s no way my parents would approve of something like that.
lines.zh: : 就算有时间，我爸妈也绝对不会同意这种事。

lines.en: : Well, luckily for you, your parents aren’t in charge of you anymore. And I hereby grant you permission to date anyone you want.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你运气好，你爸妈现在管不着你了。而我在此正式批准你和任何你想交往的人交往。

lines.en: : Thanks. Try not to be too loud though because Nodoka will hear it and start bugging me again.
lines.zh: : 谢了。不过别太大声，因为 Nodoka 会听见，然后又开始烦我。

lines.en: : I thought you'd be more worried about Rin hearing it.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你更担心 Rin 听见呢。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday24
: Oh! Would you look at the time? Better go introduce myself to the class before the bell rings!
lines.zh: : 哦！看看时间！我得赶在铃响之前进去向大家做自我介绍了！

lines.en: : Good talk, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 聊得很愉快，Sensei！

lines.en: : Make sure you email my report card to my mom!
lines.zh: : 记得把我的成绩单发邮件给我妈！

lines.en: scene black
Otoha quickly slides into the classroom, not bothering to hold the door open for me, before taking her place in the front of the room.
lines.zh: Otoha 飞快地溜进教室，连门都懒得帮我扶一下，然后在教室前排站定了自己的位置。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday25
: Ah! The Herald of the Adolescents has the improper armor set equipped!
lines.zh: : 啊！青春期先驱者装备了不合规的护甲套装！

lines.en: : Kendo Princess, my defensives are on cooldown! Cast pain suppression!
lines.zh: : 剑道公主，我的防御技能在冷却！快施放痛苦压制！

lines.en: : Let your pain be suppressed, bro.
lines.zh: : 让你的痛苦被压制吧，兄弟。

lines.en: : If Wakana can wear a gothic lolita dress to[school], I can go a few days without my blazer on.
lines.zh: : 既然 Wakana 能穿着哥特萝莉裙来[school]，那我几天不穿外套也没什么。

lines.en: : Now pay attention to the obviously female student in the front of the class.
lines.zh: : 现在请注意教室前排那位明显是女性的学生。

lines.en: : Uh...hey, everyone. I’m the obviously female Otoha Okakura.
lines.zh: : 呃……大家好。我就是那个明显是女性的 Otoha Okakura。

lines.en: : I’m friends with a few of you already but...for those of you that don’t know me, I’m a musician and a songwriter.
lines.zh: : 我已经和你们中的几位是朋友了，不过……还不认识我的各位，我是个音乐人，也是词曲作者。

lines.en: : I’m not great at introductions, so...that’s kind of all I’ve got.
lines.zh: : 我不太擅长做自我介绍，所以……差不多就这些了。

lines.en: : But if anybody has any questions for some reason, I’d be happy to answer them.
lines.zh: : 不过如果有人出于什么原因有问题想问，我很乐意回答。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday26
: Oh my god oh my god oh my god oh my god oh my god oh my god oh my god oh my god.
lines.zh: : 我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊。

lines.en: : Is she...a friend of yours, Rin?
lines.zh: : 她是……你的朋友吗，Rin？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve been trying to get her to transfer in since Christmas. Isn’t she the coolest?
lines.zh: : 是啊。从圣诞节起我就一直在劝她转过来。她是不是超酷？

lines.en: scene otohafirstday27
: She looks...really pretty...
lines.zh: : 她看起来……好漂亮……

lines.en: : I didn’t know that...we were allowed to wear pants to[school]...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我们是允许穿裤子上[school]的……

lines.en: : I kind of...want to try that...
lines.zh: : 我有点……想试试……

lines.en: scene otohafirstday28
: Really? Do you not like skirts, Sana?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你不喜欢裙子吗，Sana？

lines.en: : I like dresses, but...skirts make me feel a little exposed...
lines.zh: : 我喜欢连衣裙，不过……裙子让我觉得有点暴露……

lines.en: : But your legs are so nice and smooth and pale and cute.
lines.zh: : 可你的腿又好看又光滑，又白又可爱。

lines.en: : Probably. I wouldn’t know because I definitely don’t stare at them while you’re not looking sometimes.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。我说不准，因为我绝对没有在你不看的时候盯着它们看过。

lines.en: : Well...um...thank you...
: But...maybe I’ll...try something else out soon?...
lines.zh: : 不过……也许我……过阵子会试试别的？……

lines.en: scene otohafirstday29
: It’s like everyone from my old[school] is slowly taking over this one. I love it.
lines.zh: : 感觉就像我以前那所[school]的人正在慢慢接管这所学校。我太喜欢了。

lines.en: : Could this give Noriko Nakayama the push she needs to make a run for class president?! Could the scale be tipped in her favor?!
lines.zh: : 这会不会给 Noriko Nakayama 她所需要的推力，让她去竞选班长？！天平会不会就此向她倾斜？！

lines.en: : Find out next week in...Untitled [kumon_mi_high] Drama Show!
lines.zh: : 敬请期待下周……无题[kumon_mi_high]青春剧！

lines.en: scene otohafirstday30
: Oh, um...Noriko, right?
lines.zh: : 哦，呃……你是 Noriko，对吧？

lines.en: : Noriko! Right!
lines.zh: : Noriko！没错！

lines.en: : What’s up, Chika?
lines.zh: : 怎么啦，Chika？

lines.en: : I’ve been wondering...and it’s probably a stupid question, but like-
lines.zh: : 我一直想问……这可能是个蠢问题，不过——

lines.en: : You’re not...related to...{i}Niki{/i} in any way, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会……和 {i}Niki{/i} 有什么……亲戚关系吧？

lines.en: : I am! She’s my older sister. Are you a fan of hers?
lines.zh: : 是的！她是我姐姐。你是她的粉丝吗？

lines.en: scene otohafirstday31
: Get out.
lines.zh: : 不会吧。

lines.en: : But the bell hasn't rung yet.
lines.zh: : 可铃还没响呢。

lines.en: : There’s no way...
lines.zh: : 不可能吧……

lines.en: : You’re not messing with me, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是在耍我吧？

lines.en: : I’m like...a huuuuuuge fan!
lines.zh: : 我可是……超——级——大的粉丝！

lines.en: : I have posters of her all over my room!
lines.zh: : 我房间里贴满了她的海报！

lines.en: : Really? I’ll have to let her know! She’d be really happy to hear that.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我得告诉她！她听了肯定特别开心。

lines.en: : I could probably introduce you, you know. The new girl at the front of the class right now has already met her a bunch of times.
lines.zh: : 我也许可以介绍你们认识哦。现在站在教室前面那个新来的女生就已经见过她好多次了。

lines.en: : Please! Yes! Would she...
lines.zh: : 拜托！好啊！她会不会……

lines.en: : Um, my little sister likes her a lot too. Would it be weird to like...ask her if she could sign something for us?
lines.zh: : 呃，我妹妹也特别喜欢她。如果……问她能不能给我们签个名，会不会很奇怪？

lines.en: : Not at all. I’ll ask her the next time I see her.
lines.zh: : 一点也不会。下次见到她我就帮你问。

lines.en: : Ohhhhh my god...
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦我的天啊……

lines.en: : This like...completely changes how much I hated you for saying all that stuff about Sensei when you transferred in.
lines.zh: : 这简直……完全改变了我有多讨厌你转进来时说的那堆关于 Sensei 的话。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday32
: Heck yeah! Famous sister comes in handy once again!
lines.zh: : 太他妈对了！有个名人姐姐又派上用场了！

lines.en: scene otohafirstday25
: Oooookay...Well, it looks like no one has any questions, so-
lines.zh: : 好——吧……看来没有人有问题了，那么——

lines.en: : Excuse me, Miss. I have a question.
lines.zh: : 不好意思，小姐。我有个问题。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday33
: Nodoka? What’s up?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？怎么了？

lines.en: : It appears that you’ve yet to accept my Facebook invitation regarding the once in a lifetime opportunity I suggested in the park the other day.
lines.zh: : 看起来你还没有接受我在公园里提议的那个千载难逢的机会的脸书邀请。

lines.en: Did she actually make a real invitation for that?
lines.zh: 她真的为那事建了个正经邀请？

lines.en: I have to say, I appreciate how far she’s willing to take a joke.
lines.zh: 我得说，我很欣赏她愿意把一个玩笑做到这个地步。

lines.en: : Sensei and I can only prolong this for so many days, so if you’re uninterested, please click the “reject” button as soon as possible so I can-
lines.zh: : Sensei 和我只能把这件事拖这么多天，所以如果你没兴趣，请尽快点「拒绝」按钮，好让我——

lines.en: scene otohafirstday34
: Does anyone have {i}actual{/i} questions or is that all?
lines.zh: : 还有人有{i}正经{/i}问题吗，还是说就这些？

lines.en: : I have one!
lines.zh: : 我有！

lines.en: : Well, I guess it’s not exactly a question but more of just a statement.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过与其说是问题，不如说是一句陈述。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday35
: Oh, yeah. Sure. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 哦，好。当然。你说？

lines.en: : And sorry but...what’s your name?
lines.zh: : 还有抱歉……你叫什么名字？

lines.en: scene otohafirstday36
: Kirin Kanda.
lines.zh: : Kirin Kanda。

lines.en: : Like I said, it’s not really a question.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，这其实不是问题。

lines.en: : I just wanted to say that you’re super hot.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，你超级辣。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Uhh...well, thanks.
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯，谢谢。

lines.en: : Any time! Feel free to come hang out with Noriko and me if you’re ever bored.
lines.zh: : 随时欢迎！你要是哪天无聊了，随时来找我还有 Noriko 玩。

lines.en: : I support this! We can get the band back together!
lines.zh: : 我支持！我们可以重组乐队了！

lines.en: : I will...keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 我会……记在心上的。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday37
: And so the battle begins...
lines.zh: : 于是战争开始了……

lines.en: : Battle?...
: No...not battle.
lines.zh: : 不……不是战争。

lines.en: : Rin...you’re scaring me...
lines.zh: : Rin……你吓到我了……

lines.en: scene otohafirstday38
: Okay, well I can see that this isn’t going anywhere. So I just want to say thanks to everyone for accepting me and that...
lines.zh: : 好吧，我看得出这话题是没个完了。所以我就想说，感谢大家接纳我，然后……

lines.en: : I hope we can all get along and stuff.
lines.zh: : 希望我们大家都能好好相处什么的。

lines.en: : And I would like to thank you for having the only proper introduction that we will ever receive.
lines.zh: : 而我也要感谢你，带来了我们唯一一次像样的自我介绍。

lines.en: : Even if there are several of the girls in class who are now either openly or unopenly expressing a desire to hook up with you.
lines.zh: : 尽管班上已经有好几个女生或明或暗地表达了想和你搞在一起的愿望。

lines.en: scene otohafirstday39
: Hah...
: It’s going to be another long year, isn't it?...
lines.zh: : 这又将是一个漫长的一年，对吧？……
